text: With scope locked, Desmond Okoro makes the first real architecture decision: the actual tech stack.
Solidity, and OpenZeppelin's audited base contracts, including ReentrancyGuard, over hand-rolled primitives.
Hardhat for development and testing, Slither for static analysis, as part of the real audit process.
Base Sepolia for staging, Base mainnet for production -- an Ethereum L2, chosen for $EMBER holders' real gas costs.
Next: planning EmberStake.sol's actual functions before any Solidity gets written.
